description: The chart illustrates the performance of various large language models on two benchmarks, categorized into two main panels: "MATH-500" on the left and "AIME24" on the right, each containing three subplots labeled (a) through (f). The horizontal category axes beneath each subplot indicate model parameter sizes (such as "3B", "1.5B", "7B", "405B", "671B") or "unk" for unknown parameter sizes. The vertical value axes use a linear scale to represent performance scores; the MATH-500 panel ranges from 65 to 100 with tick mark intervals of 5, while the AIME24 panel ranges from 0 to 90 with tick mark intervals of 10, both featuring horizontal grid lines at each interval. A legend at the top maps solid bars to "CoT" (Chain-of-Thought) and hatched or diagonally striped bars to "TTS" (Test-Time Scaling), alongside color assignments for specific models. Within each subplot, the bars are grouped by comparison sets and sorted in descending order of their height. All bars are visually emphasized by exact numerical annotations and company logo icons placed inside white boxes near their top edges. In the MATH-500 panel, subplot (a) shows a blue hatched bar for 3B (78.2), a purple solid bar for unk (74.6), and a green solid bar for 405B (71.4); subplot (b) features a red hatched bar for 1.5B (91.6), a pink solid bar for unk (90.0), and a brown solid bar for unk (85.5); and subplot (c) displays the tallest overall bar in the chart, a tan solid bar for 671B (97.3), followed by an orange hatched bar for 7B (95.2) and a grey solid bar for unk (94.8). In the AIME24 panel, subplot (d) shows a blue hatched bar for 3B (30.0), a green solid bar for 405B (23.3), and the shortest overall bar in the chart, a purple solid bar for unk (9.3); subplot (e) features a pink solid bar for unk (63.6), a red hatched bar for 1.5B (63.3), and a brown solid bar for unk (44.6); and subplot (f) presents an orange hatched bar for 7B (83.3), a tan solid bar for 671B (79.8), and a grey solid bar for unk (79.2).
